specs/antigravity-auth.md.summary: Google Antigravity OAuth provider: registration, multi-account auth.json pool, PKCE login, refresh rotation and quota failover, opencode import, secret-file permissions, and SSE streaming.
specs/antigravity-auth.md.title: antigravity-auth (as-is spec)

specs/async-subagents.md.summary: Async sub-agents as pi --mode rpc children: spawn, concurrency, retry/backoff, quota model fallback, state and registry, stop/cleanup, disk layout, and tool contracts.
specs/async-subagents.md.title: async-subagents (as-is spec)

specs/browser-qa-inline-agent.md.summary: browser-qa uses one self-contained Markdown agent definition with body-to-promptAppend mapping; mandatory QA skill removal and runner protections are retained.
specs/browser-qa-inline-agent.md.title: Self-contained browser QA agent instructions

specs/clickable-markdown-links.md.summary: TUI preserves file:// and http(s) Markdown link destinations and label ranges across terminal soft-wrap for mouse hit-testing, with plain-text detection fallback.
specs/clickable-markdown-links.md.title: Clickable wrapped markdown links

specs/dcp-provider-cache-stability.md.summary: DCP prompt-cache invariants: monotonic mNNN ids on deterministic carriers, frozen reminder carriers, no assistant mutation, journal replay determinism, and bounded emergency compression returning to a stable prefix.
specs/dcp-provider-cache-stability.md.title: DCP provider-cache stability

specs/dcp-reliability-mechanisms.md.summary: DCP safety machinery covers state transactions and ownership epochs, journal replay, compression budgets, bounded artifact reads, and deterministic test walls.
specs/dcp-reliability-mechanisms.md.title: DCP reliability mechanisms (as-is spec)

specs/dcp.md.summary: DCP architecture and behavior cover journal-only persistence, canonical identity, provider-cache stability, pressure/emergency policy, and recovery over decompression.
specs/dcp.md.title: dcp: dynamic context pruning (as-is spec)

specs/desktop-attachments.md.summary: Desktop image and video attachments via picker, drag, and paste; path-backed files become ACP resource links with Pix fileImages metadata, pathless paste becomes image blocks, with Tauri path security, viewer, and size bounds.
specs/desktop-attachments.md.title: Desktop chat attachments

specs/desktop-autocomplete.md.summary: Desktop ghost-text prompt autocomplete reuses Pix autocomplete configuration through a private ACP ModelRuntime extension with debounce, cancellation, stale protection, Tab acceptance, and Escape dismissal.
specs/desktop-autocomplete.md.title: Desktop prompt autocomplete

specs/desktop-diff-view.md.summary: Desktop renders structured Edit/Write diffs and git diff shell output as inline unified diffs with TUI semantics, column-zero markers, ANSI stripping, and bounded large-replacement fallback.
specs/desktop-diff-view.md.title: Desktop diff view

specs/desktop-markdown-rendering.md.summary: Dependency-free Desktop Markdown renderer for transcript and preview popup with escaped HTML, safe links, Mermaid strict security, inline media, preview history and scroll, and confined Tauri file access.
specs/desktop-markdown-rendering.md.title: Lightweight desktop Markdown rendering

specs/desktop-project-titlebar.md.summary: macOS title-bar project selector with recent-project menu capped at 20, name-derived folder colors, native directory chooser, traffic-light alignment, drag region, and recent-project persistence.
specs/desktop-project-titlebar.md.title: Desktop project selector in the title bar

specs/desktop-question-tool.md.summary: Question tool renders as in-composer questionnaire mode through the PIX_QUESTION_RPC_BRIDGE and _pix.question ACP elicitation, supporting bounded single/multi-select questions, Preview, safe cancellation, and image/size limits.
specs/desktop-question-tool.md.title: Desktop Question Tool

specs/desktop-session-parity.md.summary: session/list reconciles native Pi JSONL sessions into the ACP map with stable ids and reports a namespaced TUI tab snapshot for Desktop/TUI parity.
specs/desktop-session-parity.md.title: Desktop and TUI session parity

specs/desktop-session-sidebar.md.summary: Read-only Desktop Session sidebar bridges versioned todo and live subagent snapshots from pi RPC through the pix.session-state widget and pix/session-state notification with per-channel freshness.
specs/desktop-session-sidebar.md.title: Desktop session sidebar

specs/desktop-slash-commands.md.summary: Desktop slash-command catalog merges ACP built-ins with Pi runtime commands and fuzzy search, including local session commands and interactive model/thinking pickers.
specs/desktop-slash-commands.md.title: Desktop slash commands and fuzzy command search

specs/desktop-tool-rows.md.summary: Desktop tool rows mirror TUI with lowercase bold names, compact arguments, family color roles, mutation diffs including replay reconstruction, and LSP attention and diagnostic colors.
specs/desktop-tool-rows.md.title: Desktop tool rows

specs/desktop-window-state.md.summary: Tauri window-state plugin persists main-window size, position, and maximized state, restoring on the same display with safe off-screen fallback.
specs/desktop-window-state.md.title: Desktop window state persistence

specs/fenced-code-block-rendering.md.summary: TUI omits fence markers while preserving syntax highlighting and theme contrast for fenced code, including streaming and empty blocks and Mermaid source fallback.
specs/fenced-code-block-rendering.md.title: Fenced code blocks in chat Markdown

specs/file-link-opening.md.summary: Local links open via Zed CLI for non-media files in Zed or via the OS opener; media always uses the OS opener.
specs/file-link-opening.md.title: File link opening

specs/idx-startup-update.md.summary: Pix starts background idx update with update/failure toasts, silent absence handling, offline and version-check opt-outs, and a ten-minute timeout.
specs/idx-startup-update.md.title: Keep idx current at Pix startup

specs/lsp-trust.md.summary: Project-local pi-tools-suite configuration is trust-gated by SHA-256 before LSP execution; global config is ungated, with persistent trust storage and silent non-interactive rejection.
specs/lsp-trust.md.title: lsp trust & command execution (as-is spec)

specs/markdown-soft-wrap-highlighting.md.summary: TUI highlights the full logical Markdown/fence line, then clips and shifts styles onto each soft-wrapped visual row so inline constructs survive terminal wrapping.
specs/markdown-soft-wrap-highlighting.md.title: Markdown soft-wrap highlighting

specs/mermaid-markdown-rendering.md.summary: TUI renders mermaid fences as Unicode diagrams via grok-mermaid with wide-diagram pagination, theme colors, streaming best effort, source fallback, and bounded render cache.
specs/mermaid-markdown-rendering.md.title: Mermaid diagrams in chat Markdown

specs/model-scope-fallback.md.summary: Session model scope follows SDK native behavior; static favorite-model list removed when enabledModels is unconfigured.
specs/model-scope-fallback.md.title: Model scope fallback

specs/openai-codex-usage-refresh.md.summary: Usage status refreshes expired Codex OAuth through pi core AuthStorage to preserve refresh-token rotation.
specs/openai-codex-usage-refresh.md.title: OpenAI Codex usage-token refresh

specs/overview.md.summary: Hand-maintained index of canonical specs and cross-cutting observations; navigation metadata rather than a primary specification.
specs/overview.md.title: Specs index

specs/parent-first-subagent-routing.md.summary: Parent-first role selection uses the LLM router only as fallback; routing errors fail spawn visibly.
specs/parent-first-subagent-routing.md.title: Parent-first sub-agent role selection

specs/project-agents-dir.md.summary: The project ships sub-agent roles as .pi/agents/*.md with bounded YAML frontmatter, merge precedence, and no-cache reload.
specs/project-agents-dir.md.title: Project-local sub-agents from `.pi/agents/*.md` (delta spec)

specs/question-inactive-tab.md.summary: The question tool pends custom UI for an inactive tab scope instead of failing; activation completes it.
specs/question-inactive-tab.md.title: question in an inactive tab

specs/retry-toast-action.md.summary: A retry action on an error toast resumes a failed turn via a hidden pix-retry continuation message.
specs/retry-toast-action.md.title: Retry action for exhausted automatic retries

specs/session-extension-bind-before-prom.summary: The first prompt waits for the active session extension bind before AgentSession.prompt().
specs/session-extension-bind-before-prom.title: Bind session extensions before prompting

specs/session-title-after-resource-comma.summary: A leading resource slash command defers title generation to the next regular user input.
specs/session-title-after-resource-comma.title: Name sessions after a leading resource command

specs/todo-clear-session-replay.md.summary: Todo slash-command mutations persist as hidden custom snapshots and replay last-write-wins.
specs/todo-clear-session-replay.md.title: Persist todo clear in session replay

specs/todo-thinking-model-overrides.md.summary: todoThinkingOverrides forces one thinking level per model for todo mutations.
specs/todo-thinking-model-overrides.md.title: Todo thinking model overrides

specs/web-search-tavily-fallback.md.summary: web_search and web_fetch use Ollama first with Tavily fallback plus /web-credentials setup.
specs/web-search-tavily-fallback.md.title: Tavily fallback for web tools
